description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Seaside Home:* The Beach is Your Backyard* 6 Bikes included * Separate Guest House with Kitchenette and Living Area* Gulf Front Patio, Outdoor Shower, and Gas Grill* 350 yards to the Seaside Town Center* Walk to Bud and Alley’s and Modica Market* Professionally Managed; 24/7 service* Watch for a vast array of common wildlife including dolphins, pelicans and butterflies!* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below**This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.** Step into a little slice of 30A history at Butterfly Bluff, a reliable family retreat above the white sandy dunes of Seagrove Beach, constructed well before Seaside was born nearby. Here, Old Florida is paired with all the modern conveniences you would expect. Walk just 350 yards to the Seaside Town Center and just 100 feet to the public beach access. Six bikes are provided for your convenience and an outdoor shower for rinsing off after a day of fun in the sun. You will love spending your evenings on the gulf front patio, cooking up your catch of the day on the gas grill, and enjoying spectacular sunsets. Windows that span the length of the home welcome you as you enter the main house, so there are breathtaking gulf views from every angle. There are plenty of cozy seating areas with those incredible views, two dining tables and a flat screen TV near the original (now decorative) fireplace. The unique waterfront dining table is original to the home and full of family memories. Other features of the main house include locally sourced cypress paneling, terrazzo floors, an upright piano and a framed puzzle with a romantic backstory. A convenient breezeway connects the two homes. The main house has a massive living/entertaining area, full kitchen and 3 bedrooms with ensuite baths for a total of 3.5 baths. The guest house has a private entrance and boasts its own living space and kitchenette along with 3 bedrooms and 2 baths. Butterfly Bluff provides a one-of-a-kind experience. Be sure to watch for monarch butterflies migrating by and discover why this lovely home is sure to become a family favorite!Bed Setup:Main House: 3 Bedrooms/ 3.5 BathsMaster Bedroom: King Bed and ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed and ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed and ensuite BathroomLiving Room: Twin Day Bed and; Twin TrundleGuest House: 3 Bedrooms / 2 BathsGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed and ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin bedsLiving Room: Sofa sleeperArea Attractions:Seaside is a fantastic destination in walking distance and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
